purpose: Profile the exact already-frozen kernel-result eligibility deficits for the 39 Candidate-58 cases classified by immutable Gate2B0 as KERNEL_NONDEFINITIVE. This gate performs no semantic rerun, no source reinterpretation, no truth/operator join, and no remediation. It treats the frozen kernel result as the scientific observation and independently checks only its identity and internal bookkeeping consistency before descriptive profiling.

frozen_kernel.role_in_gate2b1: normative description of the already-frozen result fields and dependency bookkeeping only; Gate2B1 does not import or execute it

population_lock.selector: Select exactly and only case_id values whose immutable Gate2B0 frontier equals KERNEL_NONDEFINITIVE.

allowed_scientific_inputs: the exact immutable Gate2B0 frontier ledger above
the exact immutable first-complete machine matrix above
within the exact immutable machine-bundle ZIP, only replay1/cases/<selected_case_id>/kernel_result.json and replay2/cases/<selected_case_id>/kernel_result.json bytes
read_surface.zip_metadata_allowed: ZIP central-directory metadata may be read only to validate member count, path safety, uniqueness, and the existence of the exact permitted kernel-result members.
forbidden_content_reads: machine_record.json beyond the already-frozen machine matrix
Gate2A truth-joined ledger or Gate2A metrics
truth oracle, expanded truth, canonical expected labels, gold verdicts

per_selected_case: Require exactly one replay1 and one replay2 member at cases/<case_id>/kernel_result.json under their respective replay roots.
Require replay1 and replay2 kernel-result bytes to be exactly identical.
Require SHA-256 of the kernel-result bytes to equal kernel_result_sha256 already frozen in the machine-matrix row for that case_id.
Require result schema risu.e2-semantic-kernel-result/v0.1, prediction E2_PREDICTED_ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE, and empty infrastructure_reasons.
Independently recompute result_digest_sha256 as canonical SHA-256 of the kernel-result object with result_digest_sha256 removed; require exact equality.
Require admissions keys exactly A,B,C,D,E,F with frozen admission ids and boolean satisfied values plus string-list reasons.
Require obligations keys exactly the 12 frozen A3_P1..P5/A4_P1..P7 obligations with boolean values.
Require world_relation.complete boolean, world_relation.violating_pairs list, witnesses list, and unresolved string list.

Independently reconstruct the exact unresolved set from admission reasons, world completeness, collapse-without-witness, and false obligations under the frozen kernel bookkeeping rule; require set equality.

top_level_incomplete_branch_lock.rule: Classify each selected frozen kernel result into exactly one branch implied by the frozen kernel decision structure. This is an execution-state partition, not a semantic root-cause label.

branches.predicate: world_relation.complete is false and violating_pairs is empty
world_relation.complete is true, violating_pairs is nonempty, and witnesses is empty
world_relation.complete is true, violating_pairs is empty, and at least one admission is unsatisfied or at least one preservation obligation is false

fail_closed_states: world_relation.complete false with any violating pair
complete world with violating pair and any admitted witness while prediction remains incomplete
complete world with no violating pair while every admission is satisfied and every obligation is true

per_case_outputs: failed_admission_signature: NONE or plus-joined canonical ids such as A+C+F
exact admission reason strings grouped by A..F
normalized admission reason families obtained only by taking text before the first colon
residual false obligations after direct-shadow removal
aggregate_outputs: exact count for each A..F admission failure

direct_obligation_shadow_map.purpose: Avoid mechanically double-counting a false obligation whose frozen formula directly includes a failed admission predicate. Shadow means direct syntactic dependency in the frozen kernel formula, not causal priority and not a remediation claim.

reason_normalization_lock.reason_family_rule: For descriptive aggregation only, reason_family is the exact substring before the first colon, or the whole reason when no colon exists.

next_authorized_action: Implement a standard-library-only Gate2B1 analyzer that reads only the allowed frozen surfaces, independently verifies kernel-result identity and bookkeeping consistency, emits the locked admission/obligation profile without result-dependent taxonomy changes, freeze its exact blob identity, then execute two deterministic replays and immutably freeze the first complete Gate2B1 result.
